status.en: 9 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 25% fewer than the week before, most of them in Dioura, Niamey and Kidal.
status.nb: 9 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 25 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Dioura, Niamey og Kidal.

summary.en: Algerian troops have entered Niger to protect energy assets as jihadist attacks surge, while Niger's NSCDC cell incident killed 14 children among 33 detainees due to overcrowding and asphyxiation. Russian-affiliated forces continue killing civilians in Mali and Russia hosted an African leaders summit to deepen ties, with Putin seeking expanded relations with African countries. Niger accused Chad of a drone strike that killed two civilians, and a convoy carrying Governor Bago crashed, killing four students, a driver and a young woman. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Algeriske tropper har gått inn i Niger for å beskytte energianlegg mens jihadistangrepene øker, mens NSCDC-cellen i Niger drepte 14 barn blant 33 fanger på grunn av overbefolkning og kvelning. Russisk-tilknyttede styrker fortsetter å drepe sivile i Mali og Russland var vertskap for et toppmøte for afrikanske ledere for å styrke båndene, der Putin søker utvidede relasjoner med afrikanske land. Niger anklaget Tsjad for et droneangrep som drepte to sivile, og en konvoi med guvernør Bago styrtet, og drepte fire studenter, en sjåfør og en ung kvinne. Konflikten ga 4 159 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: War in the Sahel
background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known synonymously as the Sahel War is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. In particular, the intensive conflict mainly takes place in the three countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
